## Sub-Provincial Farm Count

```{r}
# Load library
library(pacman)
p_load(cansim,
       dplyr,
       data.table,
       tidyr,
       stringr)

# STEP 1: Load Census of Agriculture data for BC total and Census Division (CD) in 2021 by farm type and for total farms which INcludes farms with less than $10K in revenue

CensusAg_AllFarmTypes <- get_cansim("32-10-0231-01") %>%
  # Rename variables for ease
  rename(
    `Farm type` = `North American Industry Classification System (NAICS)`,
    CensusAgValue = val_norm) %>%
  # Convert Date to year, GEO and Farm type to character
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Farm type` = as.character(`Farm type`),
    GEO = as.character(GEO)) %>%
  # Filter for certain GEO and commodity groups
  filter(
    GEO %in% 
      c("British Columbia [PR590000000]",
        "Capital, British Columbia [CD590117000]",
        "Cowichan Valley, British Columbia [CD590119000]",
        "Nanaimo, British Columbia [CD590121000]",
        "Alberni-Clayoquot, British Columbia [CD590123000]",
        "Strathcona, British Columbia [CD590124000]",
        "Comox Valley, British Columbia [CD590126000]",
        "Powell River, British Columbia [CD590127000]",
        "Mount Waddington, British Columbia [CD590143000]",
        "Central Coast, British Columbia [CD590145000]",
        "Fraser Valley, British Columbia [CD590209000]",
        "Greater Vancouver, British Columbia [CD590215000]",
        "Sunshine Coast, British Columbia [CD590229000]",
        "Squamish-Lillooet, British Columbia [CD590231000]",
        "Okanagan-Similkameen, British Columbia [CD590307000]",
        "Thompson-Nicola, British Columbia [CD590333000]",
        "Central Okanagan, British Columbia [CD590335000]",
        "North Okanagan, British Columbia [CD590337000]",
        "Columbia-Shuswap, British Columbia [CD590339000]",
        "East Kootenay, British Columbia [CD590401000]",
        "Central Kootenay, British Columbia [CD590403000]",
        "Kootenay Boundary, British Columbia [CD590405000]",
        "Cariboo, British Columbia [CD590541000]",
        "Fraser-Fort George, British Columbia [CD590553000]",
        "Skeena-Queen Charlotte, British Columbia [CD590647000]",
        "Kitimat-Stikine, British Columbia [CD590649000]",
        "Bulkley-Nechako, British Columbia [CD590751000]",
        "Stikine, British Columbia [CD590757000]",
        "Peace River, British Columbia [CD590855000]",
        "Northern Rockies, British Columbia [CD590859000]"),
    `Farm type` %in% 
      c("Total number of farms",
        "Oilseed and grain farming",
        "Other vegetable (except potato) and melon farming",
        "Potato farming",
        "Fruit and tree nut farming ==> Total number of farms",
        "Greenhouse, nursery and floriculture production",
        "Other crop farming",
        "Beef cattle ranching and farming, including feedlots",
        "Dairy cattle and milk production",
        "Hog and pig farming ==> Total number of farms",
        "Poultry and egg production",
        "Other animal production")) %>%
  # Rename GEO and farm type categories
  mutate(
    GEO = case_when(
      GEO == "British Columbia [PR590000000]" ~ "British Columbia",
      TRUE ~ str_remove(GEO, ",.*")),
    `Farm type` = case_when(
      `Farm type` == "Total number of farms" ~ "All farm types",
      TRUE ~ str_remove(`Farm type`, " ==> Total number of farms"))) %>%
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, `Farm type`, CensusAgValue) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, GEO),
    names_from = `Farm type`,
    values_from = CensusAgValue) %>%

  # Calculate residual "All other farms" as the difference between the total farms count and the sum of all farm types in BC and for each CAR using the Census of Agriculture
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)),
         `All other farms` =
           `All farm types` -
           (`Oilseed and grain farming` +
              `Other vegetable (except potato) and melon farming` +
              `Potato farming` +
              `Fruit and tree nut farming` +
              `Greenhouse, nursery and floriculture production` +
              `Other crop farming` +
              `Beef cattle ranching and farming, including feedlots` +
              `Dairy cattle and milk production` +
              `Hog and pig farming` +
              `Poultry and egg production`+
              `Other animal production`))

# STEP 2: Load ATDP data for BC total in 2021 to the most recent year available for total farms which EXcludes farms with less than $10K in revenue
ATDP_AllFarmTypes <- get_cansim("32-10-0136-01") %>%
  # Rename variables for ease
  rename(
    ATDPValue = val_norm) %>%
  # Convert Date to year, Farm type, GEO and 
  mutate(
    Date = year(Date),
    `Farm type` = as.character(`Farm type`),
    GEO = as.character(GEO),
    Estimates = as.character(Estimates),
    `Estimate type` = as.character(`Estimate type`),
    `Revenue class` = as.character(`Revenue class`)) %>%
  # Filter for BC, date and commodities
  filter(
    Date >= 2021,
    GEO == "British Columbia",
    `Farm type` == "All farm types",
    Estimates == 'Number of farms',
    `Estimate type` == "Farms reporting",
    `Revenue class` == "All revenue classes") %>%
  # Keep only required variables
  select(Date, GEO, `Farm type`, ATDPValue)

# STEP 3: Calculate the 2021 ratio = ([Census of Agriculture BC total farm count] / [ATDP BC total farm count])
BC_AllFarmType <- CensusAg_AllFarmTypes %>%
  # Pivot long by farm type
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !c(Date, GEO),
    names_to = "Farm type",
    values_to = "CensusAgValue") %>%
  # Join Census of Ag 2021 with ATDP 2021 onwards
  right_join(
    ATDP_AllFarmTypes,
    by = c("Date", "GEO", "Farm type")) %>%
  # filter for only all farm types
  filter(
    `Farm type` == "All farm types") %>%
  # Calculate ratio
  mutate(Ratio = CensusAgValue / ATDPValue) %>%
  # Fill Ratio up and down
  fill(Ratio, .direction = "downup") %>%
  
# STEP 4: Apply the 2021 ratio to all consequent years in ATDP to get total BC for all farm types to estimate annual total farms Including farms with less than $10K in revenue
  mutate(
    AdoptedValue = coalesce(CensusAgValue, ATDPValue * Ratio)) %>%
  # Drop columns
  select(-c(ATDPValue, CensusAgValue, Ratio))

# STEP 5: Calculate each farm type's ratio to all farm types in for each region in 2021 using Census of Agriculture data
CensusAg_Ratio <- CensusAg_AllFarmTypes %>%
  # Filter for BC total only
  filter(GEO == "British Columbia") %>%
  # Valculate each farm type's ratio
  mutate(
    across(
      -c(Date, GEO, `All farm types`),
      ~ .x / .data[["All farm types"]])) %>%
  # Drop the column All farm types
  select(-`All farm types`)

# STEP 6: Apply each farm type's ratio to all farms for each region (calculated in previous step) to each year's estimate for each farm type
BC_by_FarmType <- BC_AllFarmType %>%
  # Join Census of Agriculture ratios
  left_join(
    CensusAg_Ratio,
    by = c("Date", "GEO")) %>%
  # Fill farm type ratios up and down
  group_by(GEO) %>%
  arrange(Date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  fill(
    -c(Date, GEO, `Farm type`, AdoptedValue),
    .direction = "downup"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Multiply farm type ratios by AdoptedValue
  mutate(
    across(
      -c(GEO, Date, `Farm type`, AdoptedValue),
      ~ .x * AdoptedValue
    )) %>%
  # Rename AdoptedValue to All farm types
  rename(
    `All farm types` = AdoptedValue) %>%
  # Drop columns
  select(-`Farm type`) %>%
  # Pivot long
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Date, GEO),
    names_to = "Farm type",
    values_to = "AdoptedValue")
  
# STEP 7: Calculate ratio of each region to BC for all farm types in 2021 using Census of Agriculture data. 
CensusAg_RegionRatio <- CensusAg_AllFarmTypes %>%
  # Pivot long to drop farm type
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Date, GEO),
    names_to = "Farm type",
    values_to = "Value") %>%
  # Pivot wide by GEO
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, `Farm type`),
    names_from = GEO,
    values_from = Value)  %>%
  # Calculate each region's ratio to BC total
  mutate(
    across(
      -c(Date, `Farm type`),
      ~ .x / .data[["British Columbia"]])) %>%
  # Pivot long by GEO
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Date, `Farm type`),
    names_to = "GEO",
    values_to = "Region_Ratio")

# STEP 8: Apply each regions' ratio to BC total for each year and each farm type
BC_FarmType_Region <- CensusAg_RegionRatio %>%
  # Join Census of Agriculture ratios
  full_join(BC_by_FarmType, 
            by = c("Date", "Farm type", "GEO")) %>%
  # Pivot wide by Date
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(`Farm type`, GEO, Region_Ratio),
    names_from = Date,
    values_from = AdoptedValue) %>%
  arrange(`Farm type`) %>%
  # Fill 2021 down
  fill(`2021`, .direction = "down") %>%
  # Fill all other columns up
  fill(
    -c(`Farm type`, GEO, Region_Ratio, `2021`),
    .direction = "up") %>%
  # Drop where Region_Ratio = NA
  filter(!is.na(Region_Ratio)) %>%
  # Multiply all columns except Farm type, GEO, and Region_Ratio
  mutate(
    across(
      -c(`Farm type`, GEO, Region_Ratio),
      ~ .x * Region_Ratio)) %>%
  # Pivot long by Date
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(GEO, `Farm type`, Region_Ratio),
    names_to = "Date",
    values_to = "Value") %>%
  #convert Date to year
  mutate(
    Date = as.numeric(Date))
```
